title: River public-belief CFR feasibility
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: A posterior-range, exact-terminal river CFR solver will produce reproducible low-regret strategy targets across independent solver seeds, avoiding the unstable point-action labels and from-zero whole-game approximation that failed earlier.
material_change: Add a read-only Standard10-reach river public-state sampler and tabular external-sampling CFR solver over private-hand information sets; test geometric iteration convergence and cross-seed strategy stability before changing any learned weights.
baseline: No river belief solver; prior posterior one-step action targets had 26.6% dev/confirm agreement and current from-zero Deep CFR lost 473.5 bb/100 to Standard10.
notes: Preregistered gates: exact zero-sum payoff symmetry; no illegal actions; mean external-regret proxy decreases from 128 to 2048; cross-seed root-strategy mean TV <=0.10 and greedy agreement >=0.80 at 2048; no policy training unless all integrity and stability gates pass.

The preregistered python -m form was rejected before execution because alpha_holdem is not installed at repo root; corrected to the project-standard direct script command. No solver output or hands existed when corrected.
Checkpoint-backed contract preflight only; its outputs are excluded from the preregistered six-state statistics.

Post-run raw audit corrects only the coverage gate scope from all geometric snapshots to the final 2048 checkpoint; original summary remains immutable. Stability TV/agreement thresholds and all solver evidence are unchanged.

result.summary: Six balanced frozen-Standard10 river public states, 48 history-consistent private hands per player, three independent solver seeds, and 73,728 external-sampling traversals completed with exact zero-sum and legality integrity. Mean root regret proxy fell from 116.69 at 128 iterations to 61.02 at 512 and 26.41 at 2,048, but final cross-seed root strategies remained unstable: pooled TV 0.3976 and greedy agreement 0.3970. A hash-bound post-run audit corrected an overly broad coverage bookkeeping gate and confirmed all 18 final cells covered 48/48 root hands; the stability failure was unchanged.
result.conclusion: The belief-correct exact-terminal river CFR mechanism shows a strong geometric regret-convergence signal but is materially underconverged at 2,048 iterations. No target may be distilled from this run. This is insufficient solver dose, not a demonstrated mechanism collapse.
result.next_step: Run one separately preregistered deeper convergence control on the immutable six public states and selected ranges, extending solver checkpoints geometrically to 8,192 and 32,768 iterations with restartable per-state/seed evidence. Continue only if cross-seed TV and greedy agreement improve monotonically toward the original thresholds; otherwise close this solver configuration as too sample-inefficient on current hardware.
